# Issue #003: Sovereign DACH Ops Stack — XRechnung AP Automation, BSI C5 Collaboration & AI Act Governance

- **Published:** 2026-11-23
- **Publisher:** OpsKanon (by VeriTakt Collective)

## Executive Summary
Why German and EU mid-market buyers increasingly consolidate around sovereign DACH tools with native XRechnung 3.0, BSI C5 encryption, and unified NIS2/AI Act audit trails.

## Lead Insight
Procurement teams in 2026/2027 reject fragmented US-hosted point tools when a single audit failure stalls vendor onboarding. Pairing deterministic pre-accounting (Candis, sevDesk) with German-hosted ops (Stackfield) and unified compliance (SECJUR, Kertos) cuts vendor-review cycles in half.

## Featured Directory Listings
- **Candis** (E-Invoicing & Audit Automation) — AI-assisted accounts payable, approval workflows, and XRechnung 3.0 / ZUGFeRD 2.3 processing for German SMEs. [B2B SaaS from ~149-389 EUR/month (tiered)]
- **SECJUR** (EU Compliance & AI Governance) — Hamburg-based Digital Compliance Office automating GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2, and EU AI Act readiness. [B2B SaaS (Custom Quote)]
- **Stackfield** (B2B Workflow & Lead Ops) — End-to-end encrypted project, workflow, and team collaboration hosted exclusively in Germany (ISO 27001 & BSI C5). [Cloud tiered / On-Prem from ~28 EUR/user/mo]
- **Productive** (Agency Finance & Margin Ops) — All-in-one agency operations suite covering budgeting, resource planning, and real-time margin forecasting. [SaaS from ~9 USD/user/month]
- **sevDesk** (E-Invoicing & Audit Automation) — Cloud accounting and GoBD-compliant XRechnung & ZUGFeRD invoicing for DACH SMEs and freelancers. [SaaS from ~8.90 EUR/month (tiered)]

# Issue #001: Why Static Calculators & Verified Checklists Outconvert SaaS Bloat in 2026

- **Published:** 2026-11-22
- **Publisher:** OpsKanon (by VeriTakt Collective)

## Executive Summary
How boutique agencies and DACH SMEs cut margin leakage by 15-30% using zero-macro spreadsheets, deterministic validation, and self-serve Stripe workflows.

## Lead Insight
Buyers in B2B ops are fatigued by 49 EUR/month dashboards that require weeks of onboarding. Tools that deliver an instant answer in the browser (like MarginProof's 4 calculators) and hand off to a portable template convert faster with near-zero support overhead.

## Featured Directory Listings
- **MarginProof Operations Stack** (Agency Finance & Margin Ops) — Rate calculators, retainer scope-creep defense & multi-currency tax reserve workbooks. [One-time 19-49 EUR (Payhip) / 3,500-7,500 EUR Rollout]
- **EchoMoral EU AI Act & Policy OS** (EU Compliance & AI Governance) — Risk classification, NIS2/DORA readiness matrices and contract redlining playbooks. [Planned B2B Portal (Phase 1/2)]
